title: Trustless and Bias-Resistant Game-Theoretic Distributed Randomness
venue: IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Cryptocurrency
note: ICBC 2023 poster; the same project was developed into the MARBLE 2023 full paper.
abstract: The protocol studies how participants can be incentivized to contribute genuinely random choices instead of arbitrary inputs. It constructs a matrix game supporting uniform random strategies and uses this idea for distributed randomness. This ICBC poster is an early publication of the project later developed in Game-Theoretic Randomness for Proof-of-Stake.
summary: Designs a game whose equilibrium incentivizes uniform random contributions to a distributed randomness protocol.
